name: Curtains
overview: The Scriptures detail the construction of curtains for the tabernacle's court, emphasizing precise measurements and materials such as fine twined linen, brass pillars, and silver hooks. These hangings surrounded the tabernacle on all sides, with specific lengths and numbers of pillars to establish a sacred boundary. This careful design reflects the importance of holiness and separation in the worship of God, as seen in the detailed instructions for the south, north, west, and east sides, as well as the gate.
